content:
nora: Quick idea 12pm free-throw sudden-death in the garage hoop tomorrow? Loser buys lunch. :money_with_wings: :basketball:
ishan: i'm in if sudden-death means one shot on the buzzer. high drama. :eyes:
tara: also in. can we have a tiny MVP pool for the playoffs while were at it? $1 to guess league MVP, winner gets the 'trophy mug'.
ezra: very specific prize. i like it. rules for free-throw: each player gets 3 shots, if tied goes to single-shot sudden-death. loser buys lunch for the whole group?
nora: small group only pays losers buy winner lunch (max $20). i can Venmo the pot then distribute. funds-bot: Tip: include your slack handle in Venmo notes.
ishan: i'm proposing a 'bank shot' house rule 1 point if you ricochet off the backboard and it goes in. more fun that way.
tara: vote: bank shot bonus? :+1: yes, :-1: no
funds-bot: Poll created: "Bank shot bonus for free-throw?" Options: 👍 Yes, 👎 No. Expires in 12h.
ezra: MVP pool format: $1, pick before kickoff, tiebreaker = total playoff points scored by MVP in the final. winner takes the mug and a bag of chips.
ishan: sign me up for both. Venmo will be @ishan-pay (note: "FF+MVP").
tara: sign me up :raised_hands: (i'm terrible at free-throws, great at trash talk)
nora: spreadsheet here: https://tiny.redwood/freethrow-mvp — i'll lock picks 15 mins before start. post emoji to confirm entry.
ezra: logistics: garage hoop is a little dusty, bring a pump and wipes. i'll bring the speaker and a tiny bell for the buzzer. :bell:
calendar-bot: Event created: "Garage Free-Throw Sudden-Death + MVP Pool" Tomorrow 12:15pm 12:35pm. Invite sent to #random.
ishan: side-bet idea: if someone makes 3/3 perfect then everyone else must wear the winner's choice of flair (sticker) for the afternoon. high stakes.
tara: accepted. also mandatory celebratory GIF thread if you win. no exceptions.
nora: ok final: bank shot bonus ON, losers buy winner lunch (up to $20), $1 MVP pool, pics/GIFs required. see y'all tomorrow.
funds-bot: Reminder: Venmo @nora-office (note "free-throw + MVP") due by 11:45am tomorrow.
